title: Apollo GraphQL Summit
summary: Event brand and environmental design for GraphQL Summit by Apollo -- entrance and stage signage, lounge and venue branding, keynote slides, and digital displays.
overview: Event brand and environmental design for GraphQL Summit by Apollo, including entrance and stage signage, lounge and venue branding, keynote presentation slides, and digital displays. Built as a standalone case study -- not a full company collection -- since Apollo GraphQL is a single, self-contained event engagement.
